--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,32 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result), ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only), ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
+        if (arr > 0).any():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only nonpositive values")
+    # Check shapes match
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
+        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
+    # Validate tau_filter
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+    # Compute margins: improvement over both baselines
+    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    sum_call_only = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    sum_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    margin = np.minimum(sum_with - sum_call_only, sum_with - sum_no)
+    keep = margin > tau_filter
+    return (keep, margin)
